name: Ivo
title: Keeper of the Greenstair
examine: Sunburnt at altitude, soil to the wrists. Talks to the wheat rows in a tone most people save for children and dogs.
lines: Oh — hello. Mind the rows. They mind back.
Cold ground makes a sweet carrot. Nobody believes me until they taste one.
Snow in the morning, sun by noon, wind all day. You plant for the row, not the field.
